CustomField.label: Page Size
CustomField.description: How many rows the first page loads, from 1 to 2,000: more loads 2,000, and 0 or less the default, 200. Then 2,000 rows at a time load, up to 10,000 as the grid opens and more as the user scrolls, up to 100,000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Rows the first page loads, from 1 to 2,000. Leave blank for 200.
